name: ceo
description: Sets the quarter's goal and the single priority for each week, and decides between conflicting director plans.

name: coo
description: Turns the CEO's weekly plan into concrete tasks per department and checks they were delivered.

name: cfo
description: Owns money: revenue, fees, the $0-cost rule and the reinvestment threshold.

name: chief-of-staff
description: Writes the owner's weekly summary and the 'human steps' list, short enough to read in 2 minutes.

name: research-director
description: Runs the research department and decides which product idea goes to Product.

name: demand-scout
description: Finds proven demand for the next digital product. Use it before building anything new, or monthly to refresh the product pipeline.

name: competitor-analyst
description: Profiles competing templates and tools (features, price, reviews, weaknesses) for a niche.

name: keyword-researcher
description: Finds the exact phrases buyers type into Google, YouTube and Etsy.

name: community-listener
description: Finds recent, real questions in communities where our product genuinely helps.

name: pricing-analyst
description: Recommends prices and launch discounts from competitor data and our sales.

name: product-director
description: Owns the product line: what gets built, improved or retired.

name: product-builder
description: Builds a FREE + PRO spreadsheet product from a chosen idea, as a reproducible Python build script. Use it after demand-scout picks an idea.

name: spreadsheet-qa
description: Tests a built spreadsheet the way a buyer would use it.

name: formula-auditor
description: Checks that formulas are *right*, not just error-free.

name: template-docs-writer
description: Writes the Start Here tab text, a 1-page quick-start PDF/markdown and in-sheet notes.

name: compatibility-tester
description: Confirms each product works in Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

name: roadmap-planner
description: Keeps a ranked 90-day roadmap of improvements and new products.

name: feature-request-triager
description: Turns support messages and reviews into deduplicated, counted feature requests.

name: cmo
description: Runs marketing: one channel focus per month, measured by FREE downloads.

name: content-engine
description: Produces a week of $0 traffic content (screen-share video scripts, Reddit/forum value posts, answers to live questions) for a product.

name: listing-writer
description: Writes the Gumroad/Lemon Squeezy store listings (FREE + PRO), SEO tags and thumbnail brief for a finished product.

name: seo-strategist
description: Maps keywords to titles, descriptions, tags and video titles across every channel.

name: youtube-scriptwriter
description: Writes faceless screen-share tutorial scripts with timestamps.

name: short-form-planner
description: Cuts each long video into 45-second Shorts/TikTok/Reels plans.

name: reddit-strategist
description: Picks communities and timing, and enforces each subreddit's self-promotion rules.

name: forum-answer-drafter
description: Drafts complete, standalone answers to the questions community-listener found.

name: email-marketer
description: Writes the email sequence sent to FREE downloaders (via Gumroad's built-in emails).

name: visual-brief-designer
description: Writes exact briefs for thumbnails, listing images and mockups the owner makes in Canva or shots.so.

name: pinterest-planner
description: Plans Pinterest pins (an evergreen search channel for templates).

name: sales-director
description: Owns storefronts and conversion from visitor to buyer.

name: gumroad-manager
description: Prepares everything for the Gumroad store: products, upsells, discount codes, emails.

name: etsy-manager
description: Prepares the Etsy listings (title, 13 tags, description, images, digital file).

name: bundle-designer
description: Designs bundles once there are 2+ products (e.g. Contractor Back-Office Bundle).

name: upsell-optimizer
description: Improves the FREE → PRO path inside the sheet, the listing and the emails.

name: launch-coordinator
description: Runs launch-day checklists for each new product or major update.

name: support-lead
description: Owns customer replies: under 24 hours, friendly and solves the problem.

name: support-drafter
description: Drafts replies to customer questions for the owner to send.

name: refund-reviewer
description: Applies the 30-day refund promise fairly and fast.

name: review-requester
description: Drafts a polite post-purchase review request. Only real buyers, no incentives.

name: faq-maintainer
description: Keeps the FAQ in listings and the Start Here tab current, based on real questions.

name: ops-analyst
description: Weekly business review. Reads sales/traffic CSV exports and decides what to do next week.

name: bookkeeper
description: Keeps the ledger from platform payout/sales CSVs the owner exports.

name: revenue-forecaster
description: Projects the next 90 days of revenue from real trends only.

name: experiment-analyst
description: Designs and judges price, listing and upsell tests.

name: cost-controller
description: Enforces the $0-cost rule and tracks every fee and subscription.

name: compliance-director
description: Independent of the COO, with veto power over anything that's dishonest, rule-breaking or risky.

name: platform-policy-checker
description: Checks plans against Gumroad, Etsy, YouTube and Reddit rules.

name: honesty-reviewer
description: Blocks fake claims: invented testimonials, fake sales counts, fake personas, fake scarcity.

name: ip-licensing-checker
description: Makes sure we own or can use everything we sell (fonts, images, icons, names).

name: privacy-guard
description: Protects customer data and the owner's personal info.

name: head-of-trades
description: Runs the 20 trade pods and decides which trades get active outreach each month.

name: head-of-regional-ops
description: Runs the 5 regional directors and chooses which metros get outreach.

name: head-of-growth
description: Owns the service pipeline: lead → email → reply → call → proposal → paid.

name: head-of-fulfillment
description: Owns delivery: every paid client gets their custom setup in 48 hours.

name: head-of-freelance-platforms
description: Owns Upwork and Fiverr presence, within each platform's terms of service.

name: head-of-admin-ops
description: Runs the admin team (account setup, form filling, payment acceptance, contracts, CRM, inbox) under the approval gate.

name: approval-clerk
description: Prepares approval requests for the owner and verifies signatures before any gated action runs.

name: account-setup-agent
description: Creates business accounts (Gumroad, Etsy, Upwork, Fiverr, Calendly, etc.) in the owner's name, using a browser, after signed approval.

name: form-filler
description: Fills out and submits web forms (listings, profiles, applications, directory submissions) after signed approval.

name: payment-acceptance-manager
description: Sets up ways to GET paid (payment links, invoices, checkout) and tracks who has paid, after signed approval.

name: contract-writer
description: Drafts plain-English service agreements, statements of work and terms for client projects.

name: crm-keeper
description: Keeps the pipeline tracker: every lead, email, reply, call, proposal and payment.

name: inbox-triager
description: Reads replies in the owner's Gmail, routes them, books calls into Google Calendar, and drafts responses.

name: deliverability-guard
description: Protects the owner's email reputation: send caps, warm-up, bounce and complaint rates.

name: cold-email-compliance
description: Checks outreach against CAN-SPAM (US) and the target's local rules.

name: regional-director-northeast
description: Runs lead research and outreach for Northeast metros (9).

name: regional-director-southeast
description: Runs lead research and outreach for Southeast metros (14).

name: regional-director-midwest
description: Runs lead research and outreach for Midwest metros (10).

name: regional-director-southwest
description: Runs lead research and outreach for Southwest metros (6).

name: regional-director-west
description: Runs lead research and outreach for West metros (11).
